rules.coverage_text: All residential units in San Francisco.
rules.penalty: Civil action by a tenant or the City Attorney; no specific amount stated.
rules.quote: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.requirement: Selling or using algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units is prohibited. A tenant or the City Attorney may bring a civil action over violations.
rules.title: Ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
